mintAuthority.summary: NUSD is the Synapse nexus-pool LPToken: mint is restricted to its SwapFlashLoan pool owner, and supply expands when LPs add liquidity. Both token and pool are fixed EIP-1167 clones. The pool is owned by a 2-of-3 Safe with an enabled transfer-only Allowance Module and no guard.

controls.label: Synapse SwapFlashLoan pool (sole NUSD minter)
controls.capDescription: Only onlyOwner can call mint() on the LPToken; the sole owner is the SwapFlashLoan pool; minting occurs on LP deposit.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: NUSD supply expands only when LPs add liquidity to the Synapse nexus SwapFlashLoan pool.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: LPToken mint() is onlyOwner and the owner is the SwapFlashLoan pool contract.
routeChecks.caps: No independent fixed supply cap; minting is bounded by pool deposit/accounting logic.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Pool ownership is held by the separately reviewed 2-of-3 Safe.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: NUSD token Blockscout shows ContractName 'LPToken'; owner() returned 0x1116898…; Blockscout confirms that address as ContractName 'SwapFlashLoan' (Solidity 0.6.12, AGPL-3.0). Pool's own owner() = 0x67f60b0891…

controls.label: Synapse nexus-pool admin Safe (pool owner)

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Safe owns the SwapFlashLoan pool that owns the LPToken mint path. Safe v1.3 has an enabled transfer-only Allowance Module and no guard.
routeChecks.caps: Safe can administer the pool route, but the reviewed LPToken mint path remains pool-deposit/accounting driven.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527046, SwapFlashLoan pool owner() remained Safe 0x67f60b0891ebd842ebe55e4ccca1098d7aac1a55. The Safe was 2-of-3 with zero guard and module guard, standard fallback handler 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4, and enabled Allowance Module 0xcfbfac74c26f8647cbdb8c5caf80bb5b32e43134. Six delegates were configured in the module; verified module code limits them to allowance transfers and cannot replace either fixed clone target.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527046, NUSD LPToken 0x1b84765de8b7566e4ceaf4d0fd3c5af52d3dde4 and SwapFlashLoan pool 0x1116898dda4015ed8ddefb84b6e8bc24528af2d8 were 45-byte EIP-1167 runtimes embedding fixed implementations 0x6c8c6e68604e78b549c96907bfe9ebdaac04e3b3 and 0x5a5fff6f753d7c11a56a52fe47a177a87e431655. All EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero on both clones and implementations. Pool ownership remained with the 2-of-3 Safe; its enabled Allowance Module can transfer Safe-held allowances but cannot change either clone target. NUSD is the fixed pool's LP receipt: new shares require liquidity deposited into the immutable SwapFlashLoan clone, and neither the pool owner nor its Safe can replace the LPToken or pool implementation. The direct-mint encoding is therefore economically bounded by deposited pool assets. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the immutable Ethereum pool remains bounded, but the reviewed reserve reconciliation does not establish coverage for all satellite deployments and no prudential supervisor applies. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: Synapse pool and bridge documentation did not establish aggregate monitoring or independent reconciliation across every satellite NUSD mint path.
